title: Graham Hancock's yage experience of a communicating presence

tellings.quote: in in every way and again this sense of a a presence and of and and of communication.

plain: The writer Graham Hancock says that after drinking yage, a psychedelic plant brew from South America, he felt a presence with him that seemed to be communicating. He tells it as his own experience, describing "this sense of a presence and of communication," and offers it as a hint that such states put people in touch with some other intelligence.
